Ferrowmoor Brand Guidelines

Version 2.1 · For everyone who makes things in the Ferrowmoor name.

Our brand

Ferrowmoor makes field equipment for people who walk long distances in bad weather.

Personality

Steady. Practical. Warm.

Tone of voice

We speak plainly and briefly, like a good guide: we say what to do and why, and we never exaggerate.

Logo

The Ferrowmoor logo is the wordmark with the moor symbol to its left. Always use the supplied artwork.

Clear space

Keep a clear space around the logo equal to 50% of the height of the symbol.

Minimum size

The logo must never be reproduced smaller than 24px wide on screen or 15mm in print.

Logo don'ts

  • Don't stretch or distort the logo.
  • Don't recolour the logo outside the brand palette.
  • Don't rotate the logo.
  • Never place the logo on a busy photograph without a solid panel.

Colour

Our palette is built on Moor Green with Ember as the single accent. Use the accent sparingly. Only use colours from this palette.

Moor Green (primary)

HEX #2F4A3A

RGB 47 74 58

CMYK 70 30 65 55

Pantone 5605 C

Ember (accent)

HEX #D9632B

RGB 217 99 43

CMYK 0 70 90 5

RGB 243 239 230

HEX #1D1D1B

Lichen (secondary)

CMYK 35 15 35 10

Pantone 5635 C

Typography

Primary typeface

Headlines are set in Fraunces Semibold. Headlines are always set in sentence case.

Secondary typeface

Body copy is set in Inter Regular, with Inter Medium for emphasis.

Type scale

H1 48pt · H2 32pt · H3 24pt · Body 12pt · Caption 9pt

Imagery

Photography shows real people outdoors in natural, overcast light. Avoid staged studio shots and heavy filters.

Layout

Layouts use a 12-column grid with generous white space. Keep text left-aligned.

Graphic device

The contour line pattern, taken from survey maps, may be used as a quiet background texture.

Do's and don'ts

  • Do keep text on Oat or Moor Green backgrounds.
  • Don't use gradients.
  • Never set body text below 4.5:1 contrast.
